title: Memory & Context Optimization
brief: Modernize auto-memory, CLAUDE.md architecture, compaction strategy. Modularize CLAUDE.md using @-import syntax, add dynamic context injection via InstructionsLoaded hook, validate memory freshness, define compaction survival lists, implement structured memory types with proper frontmatter, automate checkpoint creation, prune MEMORY.md automatically, integrate context budget monitoring.

phases.title: Memory & Context Architecture
phases.description: Modularize CLAUDE.md, add dynamic context injection, validate memory freshness, define compaction survival, implement structured memory types, automate checkpoints, auto-prune MEMORY.md, integrate context budget monitoring, detect stale memories, optimize memory search.

units.title: CLAUDE.md modularization
units.rationale: Monolithic CLAUDE.md wastes tokens loading irrelevant context. Splitting into domain-specific includes via @-import keeps the main file under 100 lines while allowing domain-specific loading.
entry_conditions: Current CLAUDE.md exists and is readable
exit_conditions: Main CLAUDE.md < 100 lines
@-import includes work and load domain files
All existing content preserved in domain includes

steps.instruction: Audit current CLAUDE.md content, identify domain boundaries (hooks, engines, catalogs, tools, milestones).
Create .claude/includes/ directory with domain files: hooks.md, engines.md, catalogs.md, tools.md, milestones.md, preferences.md.
Rewrite CLAUDE.md to use @-import syntax referencing each include.
Verify all content accessible via includes.

units.description: CLAUDE.md modularization — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Dynamic context injection
units.rationale: InstructionsLoaded hook can inject relevant context based on which files/directories are being worked on, reducing irrelevant context loading.
exit_conditions: Context injected per domain based on active file paths
Engine work loads engine context, hook work loads hook context, etc.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create InstructionsLoaded hook that detects active working context (last edited files, current directory).
Map detected context to relevant include files from P0-U01.
Inject only relevant domain context into the session.
Test by working in src/engines/ and verifying engine context loads, then src/hooks/ and verifying hook context loads.

units.description: Dynamic context injection — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Memory freshness validation
units.rationale: Memory files reference file paths and function names that may no longer exist. A validation hook checks these references against the actual codebase to flag stale entries.
exit_conditions: Stale references flagged with file path and line number
Report written to state/CCM-MS7/memory-freshness.json
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Write memory-freshness-check.sh that extracts file paths and function names from memory/*.md files.
Check each reference against the actual filesystem.
Report stale references (file not found, function not found) with context.

units.description: Memory freshness validation — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Compaction survival list
units.rationale: When context compaction occurs, critical facts (active milestone, current branch, key decisions) must survive. A PostCompact hook verifies these facts persist.
exit_conditions: Facts survive compaction as verified by PostCompact hook
Survival list includes: active milestone, current branch, last test status, active crons
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define compaction survival list: active milestone ID, current git branch, last build status, last test pass rate, active cron count, current working files.
Update precompact-save hook to persist these facts to a survival file.
Add PostCompact verification that checks survival facts are present in resumed context.

units.description: Compaction survival list — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Auto-memory categorization
units.rationale: Unstructured memory files are hard to search and prune. Adding typed frontmatter (user/feedback/project/reference) enables automated categorization, retrieval, and lifecycle management.
exit_conditions: All memories typed with frontmatter: type, created, last_verified, scope
Types: user, feedback, project, reference, session
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define memory frontmatter schema: type (user|feedback|project|reference|session), created (ISO date), last_verified (ISO date), scope (global|track|milestone).
Write auto-categorize.sh that scans existing memory files, infers type from content, adds frontmatter.
Apply to all existing memory files.
Verify all files have valid frontmatter.

units.description: Auto-memory categorization — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Session checkpoint strategy
units.rationale: Auto-checkpoints before destructive operations and after milestone completions provide recovery points. Prevents loss of progress during failed forge runs.
features: Auto-checkpoint on destructive ops and milestone completion
entry_conditions: Git repo available for checkpoint commits/tags
exit_conditions: Auto-checkpoints created before git reset/revert/clean operations
Auto-checkpoints created after milestone unit completion
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define checkpoint triggers: pre-destructive (git reset, git clean, git revert) and post-milestone (unit exit conditions met).
Write checkpoint logic that creates a lightweight git tag with timestamp and context.
Wire into pretooluse-unified for destructive ops and posttooluse-unified for milestone detection.
Test by triggering a checkpoint and verifying the tag exists.

units.description: Session checkpoint strategy — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MEMORY.md auto-pruning
units.rationale: MEMORY.md grows unbounded, consuming context tokens. SessionEnd hook checks line count and archives old entries when it exceeds 180 lines, keeping the active file lean.
exit_conditions: Auto-pruning active on SessionEnd
Old entries archived when MEMORY.md exceeds 180 lines
Archive preserves full history

steps.instruction: Write memory-prune.sh that checks MEMORY.md line count, identifies oldest entries by last_verified frontmatter.
Move oldest entries (beyond 180-line budget) to memory-archive.md with timestamp.
Wire as SessionEnd hook or scheduled cron.
Test by temporarily lowering threshold and verifying pruning occurs.

units.description: MEMORY.md auto-pruning — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Context budget monitoring
units.rationale: ContextWindowPressureEngine already exists but is not wired into PreToolUse for real-time awareness. Integration enables proactive compaction and context shedding before hitting limits.
features: Real-time context budget awareness in PreToolUse
exit_conditions: PreToolUse hook queries context budget before tool calls
Warnings emitted at 70% and 90% capacity
Auto-compaction suggested at 90%

steps.instruction: Wire ContextWindowPressureEngine into pretooluse-unified hook.
Add threshold checks: warn at 70%, critical at 90%.
At 90%, suggest compaction or context shedding.
Test by simulating high token counts and verifying warnings fire.

units.description: Context budget monitoring — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Stale memory detector
units.rationale: Weekly or SessionStart detection of stale memories — entries referencing deleted files, completed milestones, or outdated counts — prevents context pollution with incorrect information.
features: Stale memory detection via codebase cross-reference
entry_conditions: Memory freshness validation from P0-U03 available
exit_conditions: Stale memories flagged with reason (file deleted, milestone completed, count outdated)
Report written to state/CCM-MS7/stale-memories.json
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Extend memory-freshness-check.sh to also detect: completed milestone references, outdated engine/test counts, references to renamed files.
Wire as SessionStart check or weekly cron from CCM-MS5.
Test with known stale entries and verify they are detected.

units.description: Stale memory detector — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Memory search optimization
units.rationale: Indexing memory files by type and topic enables faster retrieval without full-text scanning, reducing token cost for memory lookups.
features: Indexed memory retrieval by type and topic
entry_conditions: Memory categorization from P0-U05 complete with frontmatter
exit_conditions: Memory index file generated at state/CCM-MS7/memory-index.json
Index maps type→files and topic→files for O(1) lookup
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Write memory-indexer.sh that parses frontmatter from all memory files, extracts type and topic tags.
Build JSON index mapping type→[files] and topic→[files].
Write to state/CCM-MS7/memory-index.json.
Test retrieval by querying index for 'project' type and verifying correct files returned.
